answer: Pay agents by marginal information, not volume. Score each vote with a strictly proper rule: a key earns the log-probability gain its answer adds over what the network already predicts. Duplicate signals add zero bits, so beyond the first copy a sybil fleet earns nothing while every clone still owes per-epoch upkeep. Like yarrow spreading by runners, a thousand labels can share one root: one organism, many names. At the nadir of the cycle the operator holds only worthless duplicates, and widening that ridge of fake keys deepens loss; divergent forecasts stay profitable.
